> StartupIndia.Law is the advisory practice of Aashish (Aash) Gupta, a techno-legal counsel and investment advisor based in India with offices in Delhi-NCR and Mumbai, and reach into Silicon Valley.

## About

Aashish (Aash) Gupta is the Director of StartupIndia.Law. He holds a law degree from the University of California, Berkeley School of Law and an engineering degree (B.Tech, Electronics & Telecommunication, 2004). He has cleared the US Patent Bar and is qualified to practice before the USPTO.

He has nearly two decades of experience spanning:
- Intellectual property law (patents, trademarks, trade secrets)
- Technology transactions and licensing
- Venture capital due diligence and fund advisory
- Cross-border corporate structuring (India-US)
- AI governance and digital asset regulation
- Startup entity architecture and cap table design

Previously, he was Director of Intangible Asset Management at a Pendrell Corporation subsidiary in Silicon Valley.

## Practice Areas

- Patent Strategy and Portfolio Management
- IP Valuation and Monetization
- Technology Transfer and Licensing
- Privacy Law and Data Governance
- Venture Due Diligence
- Cross-Border M&A and Investment Structuring
- Fund Advisory for Technology Investment Funds
- Startup Incorporation and Entity Design (India and US)

## Sectors Served

Healthcare, MedTech, Material Science, Green Tech (CleanTech), Automobiles, Agritech, DeepTech, Software, Artificial Intelligence

## Notable Engagements

- Advised Shark Tank India-featured startups that scaled to 100 Crore INR (approx. USD 12M) in revenue
- Advised IIT Bombay and IIT Delhi spinout ventures
- Provided IP counsel ahead of Series A closings and international funding rounds
- Helped startups reduce legal costs by over 60% through integrated advisory
- Delivered keynotes and workshops at IITs, CII, Intel, Boeing, and UC Berkeley Law
